# 从崩溃边缘到月入3万：他用一年时间重写了整个产品

![https://static.vlogger.org.cn/website/opc-articles/article_0075.jpg](https://static.vlogger.org.cn/website/opc-articles/article_0075.jpg)

你有没有经历过这种绝望？

公司快死了。

合伙人分道扬镳。

你不得不花一年时间重写整个产品。

同时烧光积蓄，没有新功能，没有增长。

Brennan Dunn经历了这一切。

但现在RightMessage月入约3万美元，

还在增长。

而且只有他一个人。

带着两个孩子在家工作。

怎么做到的？

**【从自由职业课程到网站个性化】**

Brennan是个美国人，

住在英格兰的一个小镇上。

他之前建了一家公司叫 Double Your Freelancing——

给自由职业者和机构的课程、活动等等。

他有个大邮件列表（5万+订阅者），

但所有人都被送到同样的产品落地页。

自由职业者、机构老板、顾问、

新手、年收入50万+的人——

看到的都是同样的文案、推荐、推荐套餐。

他知道从咨询背景——

信息比媒介重要。

年收入5万的自由职业者和年收入200万的机构老板，

即使都想 close more proposals，

也有完全不同的问题。

但他的网站 treat everyone the same。

他开始用 custom code、Liquid templates、

一堆 duct tape hack 解决方案。

工作。转化率显著提高。

这让他上了Gumroad、Teachable等公司的 radar。

然后他们 hire 他帮忙 implement。

然后Ankur Nagpal（Teachable前CEO）给他打电话，

问能不能 invest 让他把解决方案变成SaaS。

剩下的就是历史了。

**【2018年：从简单到复杂】**

RightMessage原版2018年上线。

有合伙人，银行里有钱，有团队。

早期产品 focus 一件事——

让你根据邮件平台的数据 swap website content。

比如：如果行业=金融，就展示金融推荐。

但他们很快发现——

在企业市场之外，

很少有公司（尤其是他们 initial ICP 的"创作者"类型）

有 much segmentation data。

他们建了一个 glorified "if this then that" for dynamic websites，

但用户没有 data feed 进去。

当他们意识到多少的公司有这些数据，

决定进入 survey/quiz funnel 空间。

现在建了完整的 end-to-end 解决方案——

用个性化CTA generate leads ->

用 surveys 和 quizzes 获取 in-depth data ->

 personalize email campaigns ->

 personalize website when identified people return。

**【硬重启：买掉合伙人，重写一切】**

几年前，他们 failing，接近"crash and burn"。

Brennan买掉了合伙人的股份，

花了一年时间从头重写产品。

一年没有新功能给付费客户，

烧光积蓄。

Financially 和 emotionally brutal。

但这是 right call。

Old codebase 阻碍了一切。

一年多前重新上线。

现在月入约3万美元，还在增长。

**【技术栈：Monorepo】**

他们的栈：

- **Backend：**Laravel（PHP），MySQL，Redis（caching 和 job queues，跑 Horizon），
  
  Elasticsearch（event indexing 和 analytics）。

- **Frontend：**Vue 3 + TypeScript，Tailwind CSS，Pinia（state management），
  
  TanStack Query（server state）。

- **Marketing site：**Statamic（内容管理），一些 Vue.js。

- **Infrastructure：**标准东西。S3/R2（文件存储），Pusher（实时更新），Stripe（billing）。

- **AI：**用Claude（Anthropic）做AI功能，通过 OpenRouter proxy，
  
  这样可以 quickly change models。

- **Monitoring：**Sentry（error tracking），Laravel Pulse（性能监控），
  
  PostHog（产品分析）。

项目是 monorepo，

 separate apps for API、admin web app、marketing site，

加 shared packages for UI component library 和 visual flow builder。

**【Pivot的痛苦：AI挤压市场】**

完整的 rewrite 是最大的挑战。

花了一年时间重写RightMessage，

同时 still supporting existing customers on old platform——

 despite not having many of them。

意味着一年没有新功能给付费客户，

烧光积蓄。

Right call。

Old codebase 阻碍了一切。

但 financially 和 emotionally brutal。

ICP shift 也很 hard。

他们2018年上线时 target course creators 和 info-product businesses。

AI 在挤压那个市场。

ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 在吃他们的 search traffic。

所以他们得 reposition 向 SaaS、DTC ecommerce、agencies。

Ongoing transition。

如果能重来，

他会从 day one focus on agency/partner channel。

每个激活的 agency partner 带来多个 clients，

没有他的直接 involvement。

他花了太长时间 try do everything himself——

 sales、onboarding、support、strategy calls。

有 partners handle implementation 和 charge own clients for setup，

是他发现的 highest-leverage growth channel。

Wish he'd built that earlier。

他还会更 disciplined about not building features before validating demand。

他建过没人要的东西，

也 delay 过人们 begging for 的东西，

因为他在 chase something more technically interesting。

**【Solo founder带两个孩子的生活】**

作为带两个孩子的 solo founder 也很 challenging。

孩子一个4岁，一个8个月。

他还喜欢打网球、去健身房。

这意味着他必须 deliberate about how he spends his time。

没有 room for low-leverage work。

所以他得擅长 compress a lot into just a few hours a day。

Being solo founder 也有优势。

他能 ship fast，

 make decisions without consensus，

 pivot 因为他是 sole（仁慈的）dictator。

**【增长渠道：从受众到合作伙伴】**

增长方面，几个渠道 work well：

**Audience：**

Existing audience 提供 massive head start。

2018年上线时，newsletter 订阅者 already trust 他。

意味着他们还没东西卖就有客户了。

They presold。

**Content and education：**

他写 email marketing、segmentation、personalization 写了多年。

那个内容 slowly build trust but compounds。

YouTube videos 展示 specific use cases——

怎么 personalize emails，

怎么 build quiz funnels——

 drive trials。

**Demos：**

最好的转化路径仍然是和他 personal demo。

当有人在 call 上看到他们自己的网站被实时 personalize，

"aha" moment 是 immediate。

Bottleneck 一直是 get enough qualified people book one。

**Affiliates：**

1000+ affiliates 赚20% lifetime recurring commission。

他们 quiet 了一段时间（他的错，没 properly equip them），

但现在正在用 better assets 和 case studies reactivate 那个渠道。

**Agency partners：**

这是他 most excited about 的增长渠道。

Agencies 把 RightMessage setup 作为服务提供给 clients。

作为 solo business，

当 agency manage client account，

他们得到所有好处（MRR），

但客户和 agency 谈 support/onboarding/etc。

Definitely worth the commission 他们付给 agencies。

**Newsletter sponsorships：**

他们开始 sponsor newsletters 在 email marketing 和 growth 空间。

相比自己的 list 的优势——

可以 target exactly the right ICP，

而不是 broadcast 向 weighted toward declining segment 的 list。

**【给你的建议：建你懂的市场】**

Brennan的建议：

**建你已经懂的市场。**

他建 RightMessage 因为他 first 是客户。

He knew the problem intimately

 because he'd been hacking together solutions for himself。

如果你在建必须 guess customers want 的东西，

你在 disadvantage。

还有，

如果 launch 时没有 email list，

 early days 会 dramatically harder。

Even if you're not planning to launch for a year，

 start writing，start teaching，

 start building trust with people who'll eventually be your customers。

**【未来：自动化个性化】**

短期：未来几个月 hit 4万MRR。

"Unfortunately"，现在他们比 profitable 还 profitable——

因为就他一个人，开销每月约1000美元……

但他想再次 start scaling up team，

这意味着需要更多 money。

中期：继续建 agency partner program。

Formalize it more，conduct outbound recruitment。

产品方面：大力投入 AI；

刚推出新的 MCP，

customers love 用来做 "headless" RightMessage work。

已经有AI assistant 帮做 strategy，

AI-powered email personalization，

AI content generation。

Vision 是让 RightMessage look at your site，

 understand your audience，

 suggest（或 even implement）personalizations automatically。

长期：他想让 RightMessage 成为 default answer to——

"How do I stop treating every lead the same？"

无论你是 SaaS、ecommerce store、service company，

还是 whatever else，

如果你想要 same lead count 更多 conversions，

你应该 personalize。

他们想让这 easy enough，

没有借口不做。

个人方面：Be present for his family。

这些年不会回来。

Business exists to support life，not the other way around。

**【你会重建你的失败产品吗？】**

Brennan的故事告诉我们——

Failure is not the end。

Sometimes it's the beginning。

他 buy out 合伙人，

花一年时间重写，

从崩溃边缘到月入3万。

这需要 courage。

这需要 conviction。

这需要愿意 burn savings 为了 long-term vision。

不是每个人都能做到。

但那些做到的，

往往 end up with something better。

你呢？

你的产品需要 rewrite 吗？

还是你在 patch 一个 broken foundation？

有时候，

从零开始，

比 save 沉没成本更 brave。

*P.S. 想停止 treat every lead the same？

去 rightmessage.com 看看。

也许 personalization 不需要那么复杂。*

From the brink of collapse to a monthly income of 30,000: He took a year to rewrite the entire product

Have you ever experienced this despair?

The company is dying.

The partners parted ways.

You have to spend a year rewriting the entire product.

At the same time, savings are burned out, no new functions, no growth.

Brennan Dunn went through all this.

But now RightMessage earns about,000 a month,

Still growing.

And he was alone.

Working from home with two children.

How did you do that?

[From freelance courses to website personalization]

Brennan is an American,

Lives in a small town in England.

He used to build a company called Double Your Freelancing--

Courses, activities, etc. for freelancers and institutions.

He has a large mailing list (50,000 + subscribers),

But everyone was sent to the same product landing page.

Freelancers, agency owners, consultants,

Newcomer, person with an annual income of 500,000 +-

All I saw were the same copywriting, recommendations, and recommended packages.

He knew that from the consulting background--

Information is more important than media.

Freelancers with an annual income of 50,000 and agency owners with an annual income of 2 million,

Even if you all want to close more proposals,

There are completely different problems.

But his website treats everyone the same.

He started using custom code, Liquid templates,

A bunch of duct tape hack solutions.

Work. The conversion rate has been significantly improved.

This allowed him to go to radars from companies such as Gumroad and Teachable.

Then they hired him to help implement.

Then Ankur Nagpal (former CEO of Teachable) called him and

Asked if he could invest to turn the solution into SaaS.

The rest is history.

[2018: From Simple to Complex]

The original RightMessage will be launched in 2018.

There are partners, money in the bank, and a team.

Early products focus on one thing--

Let you swap website content based on email platform data.

For example: if industry = finance, display financial recommendations.

But they soon discovered--

Outside the corporate market,

Few companies (especially their initial ICP "creator" type)

There is much segmentation data.

They built a glorified "if this then that" for dynamic websites,

But users don't have data feed in.

When they realized how many companies had this data,

Decide to enter the survey/quiz funnel space.

Now a complete end-to-end solution has been built--

Use personalized CTA generate leads ->

Use surveys and quizzes to obtain in-depth data ->

personalize email campaigns ->

personalize website when identified people return。

[Hard Restart: Buy the partners and rewrite everything]

A few years ago, they failed and approached "crash and burn".

Brennan bought out the partner's shares and

It took a year to rewrite the product from scratch.

A year without new features for paying customers,

Burn all your savings.

Financially and emotionally brutal.

But this is a right call.

Old codebase gets in the way of everything.

It was re-launched more than a year ago.

The monthly income is now about US$30,000 and is still growing.

[Technology Stack: Monorepo]

Their stack:

- Backend: Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis (caching and job queues, running Horizon),
  
  Elasticsearch (event indexing and analytics).

- Frontend：Vue 3 + TypeScript，Tailwind CSS，Pinia（state management），
  
  TanStack Query（server state）。

- Marketing site: Statamic (content management), some Vue.js.

- Infrastructure: Standard thing. S3/R2 (file storage), Pusher (real-time update), Stripe (billing).

- AI: Use Claude (Anthropic) to do AI functions, and use OpenRouter proxy to
  
  This allows you to quickly change models.

- Monitoring: Sentry (error tracking), Laravel Pulse (performance monitoring),
  
  PostHog (Product Analysis).

Project is po,

separate apps for API、admin web app、marketing site，

Add shared packages for UI component library and visual flow builder.

[Pivot's Pain: AI Squeezes the Market]

Complete rewrite is the biggest challenge.

Spent a year rewriting Message,

At the same time still supporting existing customers on the old platform--

despite not having many of them。

Means no new features will be available to paying customers for a year,

Burn all your savings.

Right call。

Old codebase gets in the way of everything.

But financially and emotionally brutal.

ICP shift is also hard.

When they launched in 2018, target course creators and info-product businesses.

AI is squeezing that market.

ChatGPT and Perplexity are eating their search traffic.

So they have to reposition to SaaS, DTC ecommerce, agencies.

Ongoing transition。

If I could start over,

He will start from day one focus on agency/partner channel.

Each activated agency partner brings multiple clients,

There is no direct involvement of him.

He spent too long trying to do everything himself--

sales、onboarding、support、strategy calls。

There are partners handle implementation and charge own clients for setup,

He discovered the highest-leverage growth channel.

Wish he'd built that earlier。

He would have disciplined about not building features before validating demand.

He built things that no one wanted,

I also delay what people are begging for,

Because he's chasing something more technically interesting.

Solo founder with two kids

As a solo founder with two children, he is also very challenging.

The children are 4 years old and 8 months old.

He also likes to play tennis and go to the gym.

This means he has to specify about how he spends his time.

There is no room for low-leverage work.

So he has to be good at compressing a lot into just a few hours a day.

Being solo founder also has advantages.

He can ship fast,

make decisions without consensus，

Pivot because he is a sole dictator.

[Growth channels: From audience to partners]

In terms of growth, several channels work well:

Audience：

Existing audience provides massive head start.

When it launched in 2018, newsletter subscribers already trusted him.

Which means they have customers before they have anything to sell.

They presold。

Content and education：

He has been writing email marketing, segmentation, and personalization for many years.

slowly builds trust but compounds.

YouTube videos show specific use cases--

How to personalize emails,

How to build quiz funnels--

drive trials。

Demos：

The best transformation path is still a personal demo with him.

When someone sees their own website being personalized in real time on call,

An "aha" moment is immediate.

Bottleneck always wants to get enough qualified people book one.

Affiliates：

1000+ associates earn 20% in lifetime recurring commission.

They kept quiet for a while (his fault, not properly equipping them),

But we are now using the channels of better assets and case studies revitalize.

Agency partners：

This is his most excited about growth channel.

Agencies provides RightMessage setup as a service to clients.

As a solo business,

When agency manages client account,

They get all the benefits (MRR),

But the customer and the agency talk about support/onboarding/etc.

Definitely worth the commission they pay agencies.

Newsletter sponsorships：

They started sponsoring newsletters in the email marketing and growth space.

Advantages compared to your own list--

You can target exactly the right ICP,

Instead of broadcast to weighted downgrade segments.

[Suggestion for you: Build a market you understand]

Brennan's advice:

Build the market you already know.

He built RightMessage because he was a customer first.

He knew the problem intimately

because he'd been hacking together solutions for himself。

If you are building something that you have to guess customers want,

You are at disadvantage.

Also,

If you don't have an email list when launching,

Early days will be dramatically harder.

Even if you're not planning to launch for a year，

start writing，start teaching，

start building trust with people who'll eventually be your customers。

[Future: Automation and personalization]

Short-term: hit 40,000 MRR in the next few months.

"Unfortunately", now they are more profitable than profitable--

Because he was alone, spending about $1000 a month...

But he wants to start scaling up team again,

This means more money is needed.

Mid-term: Continue to build the agency partner program.

Formalize it more，conduct outbound recruitment。

Product aspects: Vigorously invest in AI;

Just launched the new MCP,

Customers love for "headless" RightMessage work.

There are already AI assistants to help make strategy,

AI-powered email personalization，

AI content generation。

Vision is to let RightMessage look at your site,

understand your audience，

suggest (or even implement) personalizations automatically.

Long-term: He wants RightMessage to be a default answer to--

"How do I stop treating every lead the same？"

Whether you are a SaaS, ecommerce store, or a service company,

Whatever else,

If you want more conversions like lead count,

You should personalize.

They want it to be easy enough,

There is no excuse not to do it.

Personal: Be present for his family.

Will not come back these years.

Business exists to support life，not the other way around。

[Will you rebuild your failed product?]

Brennan's story tells us--

Failure is not the end。

Sometimes it's the beginning。

He bought out partners,

Spend a year rewriting,

From the brink of collapse to a monthly income of 30,000.

This requires courage.

This requires persuasion.

This requires a willingness to burn savings for long-term vision.

Not everyone can do it.

But those who do,

Often end up with something better.

What about you?

Does your product need rewrite?

Or are you patching a broken foundation?

Sometimes,

Starting from scratch,

More brave than save sunk costs.

*P.S. Want to stop treating every lead the same?

Go to www.example.com. rightmessage.com

Maybe personalization doesn't need to be as complicated. *

崩壊寸前から月間30，000まで：彼は1年で製品全体を書き直しました

そんな絶望を経験したことはありますか？

会社は死にかけている。

パートナーは分かれます。

製品全体を書き直すのに1年かかります。

同時に燃え尽きて蓄積し、新しい機能、成長はありません。

ブレナン·ダンはそれをすべて経験した。

ライトメッセージは現在月額約3万ドルを稼いでいます

まだ成長してる

そして彼だけだった。

2人の子供と自宅で働く。

どうやったの？

フリーランスコースからウェブサイトのパーソナライゼーションまで

ブレナンはアメリカ人で、

イギリスの小さな町に住んでいる。

彼はDouble Your Freelancingという会社を立ち上げました。

フリーランサーや代理店のためのコース、イベントなど。

彼は巨大なメーリングリスト（50，000以上の購読者）を持っています。

しかし、すべてが同じ製品ランディングページに送られます。

フリーランサー、代理店のオーナー、コンサルタント、

年収50万人以上の初心者-

すべてが同じテキスト、推奨、推奨パッケージを表示します。

彼はコンサルティングの背景を知っている-

情報はメディアよりも重要です。

年収5万人のフリーランサーと年収200万人のエージェンシーオーナー

より多くの提案を求めても、

全く異なる問題もあります。

しかし、彼のウェブサイトは皆を同じように扱う。

彼はカスタムコード、液体テンプレート、

ダクトテープのハッキングソリューションの束。

仕事です。コンバージョン率が大幅に向上。

GumroadやTeachableなどの企業のレーダーに乗っている。

彼らは改良を手伝っている。

Ankur Nagpal（Teachableの元CEO）は彼に電話をかけました。

ソリューションをSaaSに変換できるかどうかを尋ねてください。

残りは歴史です。

2018年：シンプルから複雑へ

RightMessageオリジナル版2018年配信開始。

パートナーがいて、銀行にはお金があり、チームがいる。

初期製品は1つのことに焦点を当てた-

メールプラットフォームのデータに基づいてウェブサイトのコンテンツをスワップできます。

例えば、産業=金融の場合、金融アドバイスを表示します。

しかし、すぐに発見された。

企業市場以外では、

少数の企業特に、彼らのinitial ICPの“クリエイター”タイプ

セグメンテーションデータが多い。

動的なウェブサイトのための“If This Then That”を作成しました。

ユーザーにはデータフィードがない。

そのデータを持っている企業の数を知ると、

Survey/Quiz Funnel空間に入ることにした。

これで完全なエンドツーエンドソリューションが完成しました

パーソナライズされたCTA生成リード->

surveysとquizzesでin-depth data->を取得

メールキャンペーンのパーソナライゼーション->

特定された人々が戻ってくるときにウェブサイトをパーソナライズする。

ハードリブート：パートナーを買い、すべてを書き直す

数年前、彼らは失敗し、“クラッシュ&バーン”に近づいていました。

ブレナンはパートナーの株式を購入した。

製品を書き直すのに1年かかった。

有料顧客向けの新機能なしの1年間、

貯金を燃やす。

財政的にも感情的にも

それは正しい呼び出しです。

古いコードベースはすべてを妨げた。

1年以上前に再開。

現在は月額約30，000ドルで、成長しています。

（技術スタック：モノレポ）

彼らの墓：

- 背景：Laravel（PHP）、My SQL、Redis（キャッシュとジョブキュー、Horizonを実行）、
  
  Elasticsearch（イベントのインデックスと分析）

- フロントエンド：Vue 3 + TypeScript，Tailwind CSS，Pinia（状態管理），
  
  TanStack Query server state。
